follow-up time: Not specified, but recurrence was assessed
cohort: 17 patients diagnosed with incisional scar endometriosis
finding: This retrospective review of patients with scar endometriosis found that it is a rare complication that can occur after obstetrical or gynecological surgical procedures, and that complete excision is necessary for proper treatment.
mod_finding: Of the 17 patients, one had a history of vaginal birth with episiotomy and 15 had a history of cesarean section.
